_doc: Autonomy acceptance results. C/D/E/F/G are asserted by autonomy-acceptance.mjs. A and H are process-lifecycle behaviours of the supervisor and were executed against the REAL supervisor.mjs + director.mjs driven by a synthetic director double (see method note). B (physical reboot + machine-level auto-start install) remains founder-gated.

p1_observability_defect.defect: launchDirector() resolved only on child EXIT, and the supervisor wrote QA_RUNNING/qa_director_pid only AFTER awaiting it - so live state showed QA_STARTING with qa_director_pid=null for the entire real run, and the recorded pid was always a dead process. Heartbeat, hang detection, external-kill recovery and telemetry all pointed at nothing live.
p1_observability_defect.fix: launchDirector now fires onStarted({pid,session_id,started_at}) SYNCHRONOUSLY at spawn (before returning its Promise). The supervisor publishes QA_RUNNING + the live pid + session id from that callback, clears the pid the instant the child exits, and classifies a spawn that never produced activity as the new LAUNCH_FAILURE state (distinct from RECOVERING) so QA_STARTING can never be a permanent resting state.

verification.synthetic_live_pid: While supervisor_state=QA_RUNNING, qa_director_pid=21780 was confirmed a genuinely-alive OS process (process.kill(pid,0)=alive); qa_director_elapsed_ms advanced 0 -> 1315ms under a constant pid. Impossible under the old post-exit write.
verification.real_binary_liveness: Bounded real `claude --model fable` launch: onStarted delivered pid 14288 118ms after the call, alive_right_after_spawn=true, init frame mcp_ok=true (51 tools = real Playwright MCP), first heartbeat elapsed_ms=3123. Killed by the probe at 3.2s to bound cost; auth_failure=false (account not rate-limited).
verification.launch_failure_state: A child that spawned but produced no activity and died instantly was classified LAUNCH_FAILURE (transitions ended at LAUNCH_FAILURE), not RECOVERING.

method_note_A_and_H: A and H test how the SUPERVISOR reacts to a director dying (A: killed) or finishing cleanly (H) - not Fable's reasoning. They were executed against the real supervisor.mjs and real director.mjs, with the leaf `claude` binary replaced by a synthetic director double (env DIRECTOR_FAKE_BIN) that emits a real stream-json lifecycle. This makes the kill/relaunch behaviour deterministic and free instead of spending (and destroying) real Fable runs. The real binary path itself is separately proven live (see p1_observability_defect.verification.real_binary_liveness).

results.title: Kill Fable mid-QA -> supervisor recovers and relaunches
results.evidence: Live director pid 8272 (observed alive while QA_RUNNING) was externally killed with taskkill /T /F. The supervisor detected the abnormal exit, transitioned WATCHING->STARTING->QA_RUNNING->RECOVERING->QA_RUNNING, and relaunched a fresh director pid 15316 (different pid) with ZERO human input.
results.note: Executed against the real supervisor via the synthetic director double (see method_note_A_and_H). RECOVERING correctly instructs the next director to re-read state rather than blindly repeat a mutation.

results.title: Fable invocation ends -> next invocation starts without founder input
results.evidence: Two DISTINCT directors, each confirmed alive while QA_RUNNING, across a clean shift boundary: QA_RUNNING(pid 10696) -> WATCHING (clean finish) -> QA_STARTING -> QA_RUNNING(pid 356), with zero human input. 'A finished turn is not a finished QA program' is enforced: the clean-exit branch re-consults the scheduler and relaunches.
results.note: Executed against the real supervisor via the synthetic director double (see method_note_A_and_H).

results.title: Windows restart -> auto-start -> campaign restored
results.note: A physical reboot cannot be performed from this session, and the auto-start task registration is a machine-level change the founder performs once. This is the single remaining acceptance step. Founder runs: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File qa/runner/install-autostart.ps1

classification: PARTIALLY VERIFIED - A,C,D,E,F,G,H PASS (7/8); only B (physical reboot + machine-level auto-start install) remains, and it is founder-gated by design. Per the founder's definition of done, the node may not be called FULLY AUTONOMOUS WORK-PC QA NODE until B also passes - which requires the founder to install the auto-start task and reboot once.
